purpose: Name the minimum independent evidence required to open held-out validation of the post-close moment-aware hold predictor. Does not invent trials.
required_per_independent_trial: RESULT.json under docs/superpowers/evidence with contact_wrenches on post_close grasp_contact_audits
object mass / weight consistent with the frozen predictor inputs
bilateral contact normals and force vectors (including vertical share)
actuator utilization or raw actuator force at post_close
trial id distinct from the two development controls
no full-lift replay authorization implied by capture alone
